Nothing is wrong (the wait is bounded, no state changes); one-line fix if undesired: set next_attempt_at = 0 when applyForward lands in Forwarded. Not changed (instruction: no semantic changes).

pp_ledger rejects an over-long memo with a TRAP, not an Err variant: reject code CanisterError (IC0503), message 'the memo field size of 33 bytes is above the allowed limit of 32 bytes'. Shenanigans' memoRejected(GenericError.message) heuristic (NativeRewards.mo) therefore never fires against this ledger: a trap reaches nativeSubmitLeg's catch as #CallFailed and the leg would stay SubmittedUnknown (identical retry traps again) until the dedup window passes and it quarantines as reconcile. Not reachable today (memos are always the 32-byte sha256), so informational.
